blocks.text: There are different kinds of cyber threats. A virus spreads through infected files and can damage or delete data. Phishing tries to trick people into sharing passwords or personal details through fake emails or websites. Ransomware locks data and demands payment to unlock it, while spyware secretly collects user information. Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks overload websites, making them crash.
